subject: Roadshow: same-day crew redeploy after flight cancellation

To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Event Logistics <ops@eventlogistics.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Denver day2 coverage — flight cancellation for Alicia Gomez

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads-up: one of our on-site leads for Denver, Alicia Gomez, just had her flight canceled by the airline and the earliest rebook is not until tomorrow evening. That means she won't be able to make the Day 2 08:00 badge pick and the 09:00 AM staff briefing on Tuesday.

We have a hard gap at the Expo East entrance (station B) from 08:30–12:30. Can Redwood send a replacement who can get to the venue for the morning shift? We understand same-day redeploys are disruptive — happy to cover emergency transit fees.

I've attached the latest crew manifest so you can see roles. Please confirm whether someone can take Alicia's shift or if you want us to pull an alternate from local temps.

Attachments:
- crew_manifest_v3.csv

Thanks,
Sarah

sarah.lim@eventworks.com

Subject: Re: Denver day2 coverage — flight cancellation for Alicia Gomez

Thanks for the alert, Sarah — sorry to hear about Alicia. We're able to cover but need to coordinate quickly.

Plan proposal (please confirm):
- Marcus can redeploy from Seattle and be on the 11:05 am flight into DEN if you can hold the badge for him. He can arrive by ~13:30 local and cover the 14:00–18:00 shift.
- If you need full morning coverage (08:30–12:30), we can ask Tessa to take the morning but she'd need a morning flight and a hotel swap.

Questions:
1) Do you require someone on-site by 08:00 for the staff briefing, or is a 08:30 badge acceptable?
2) Can EventWorks arrange transit from DEN airport to the venue, or should we book a car service?

I'm attaching the signed travel addendum for same-day changes (Docusign_Travel_Addendum.pdf) and re-uploaded the crew manifest with role flags. Marcus/Tessa — can you each confirm availability and whether you need the hotel changed to the Hyatt Regency (venue rate)?
